result:
I would make it impossible for people to truly understand one another’s suffering and still remain indifferent to it.

If every person could, even briefly, feel the weight of what another person experiences—hunger, fear, humiliation, loss, loneliness—the world would reorganize itself around less cruelty and more care. Not because everyone became perfect, but because indifference would become much harder to maintain.
